_source.title: 从原理图导入变更
_source.example.text.0: 1. 创建测试原理图和测试 PCB
_source.example.text.1: 2. 创建板子把原理图与 PCB 关联起来（返回板子名称）
_source.example.text.2: 3. 打开 PCB 并从关联原理图导入变更
_source.example.text.3: 4. 清理：删板子、删 PCB、删原理图
_source.params.uuid: 原理图 UUID，默认为关联在同一个 Board 下的原理图
_source.returns: 导入操作是否成功，导入失败或未传入原理图 UUID 的游离 PCB 将返回 `false`

title: Import changes from the schematic
params.uuid: Schematic UUID. By default, the schematic associated with the same Board is used
returns: Whether the import operation was successful. If the import fails or the free PCB has no schematic UUID passed in, `false` is returned
